# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are provided for the latest released version. Users should
upgrade to the latest release before reporting an issue when possible.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not report security vulnerabilities in public issues or pull
requests. Use GitHub's **Report a vulnerability** option on the repository's
Security page to send a private report.

Please include, where possible:

- The affected asdf-extras version and environment.
- The impact and conditions required to reproduce the issue.
- A minimal description or proof of concept that does not expose real user data
  or credentials.

The maintainers will acknowledge reports and assess their severity and
reproducibility. Please allow time for investigation and a fix before publicly
disclosing a vulnerability. No response-time or bounty commitment is implied.
